title: Lathe: Portfolio management layer — strategic weighting, shift directions, investment profiles
description: The Lathe is the strategic layer that shapes where the wheel spins hardest. Each spoke gets a shift direction (maintain/growth/revenue/custom) with urgency and investment profiles (time, money, attention). The gardener uses lathe weights to prioritize which spokes get tended first and how much budget each gets. Combined with the Gardener Priority (G) and User Attention (U) scores, the Lathe produces an actionable morning dashboard: here's where to spend your 30 minutes, here's what the gardener will handle overnight, here's what's trending toward your goals.
acceptance_criteria: spoke_lathe.json schema defined with shift_direction, urgency, investment_profile, inter_relations
Scoring function in tools/ that combines G score + U score + lathe weights into a prioritized dashboard
Tender reads lathe weights to order pass 2 execution and allocate budget per spoke
Morning fleet report includes lathe-weighted recommendations
Inter-relation groups supported (e.g., 'e-commerce' cluster of 3 spokes)
Research mode: gardener can scan for ideas/opportunities and brief user without executing

vision.inter_relations: 0 or many groups per spoke — e-commerce, application-model, marketing, focus areas
vision.research_mode: Gardener finds ideas, does research, prepares implementation-ready briefs for easy user approval
